beaches.name: Velanio
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established beyond the rocks; the first stretch is swimwear. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to September 2023, and a January 2012 press article says the mayor proposed an official nudist designation to the municipal council; no decree is documented.

beaches.name: Milia
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the far end of the beach, near the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to September 2023; a 2023 report says FKK was painted on rocks, while a July 2022 report found nude use not possible in peak season.
